content: सु I. €1 <ab>U.</ab> (सुवति-ते) To go, move. --II. €1. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (सवति, सौति) To possess power or supremacy. --III. €5 <ab>U.</ab> (सुनोति, सुनुते; सुत; the स् of सु is changed to ष् after any preposition ending in इ or उ) .²1 To press out or extract juice. .²2 To distil. .²3 To pour out, sprinkle, make a libation. .²4 To perform a sacrifice especially the Soma (sacrifice). .²5 To bathe. .²6 To churn. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (सुषूषति-ते) --{%With%} उद् to excite, agitate. -प्र to produce, beget.

सु {%ind.%} A particle often used with nouns to form Karmadhāraya and Bahuvrīhi compounds, and with adjectives and adverbs. It has the following senses:-- .²1 Well, good, excellent; as in सुगन्धि. .²2 Beautiful, handsome; as in सुमध्यमा, सुकेशी <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Well, perfectly, thoroughly, properly; सुजीर्णमन्नं सुविचक्षणः सुतः सुशासिता स्त्री नृपतिः सुसेवितः … … सुदीर्घकालेऽपि न याति विक्रियाम् <ls>H. 1. 22</ls>. .²4 Easily, readily, as in सुकर or सुलभ <ab>q. v.</ab> .²5 Much, very much, exceedingly; सुदारुण, सुदीर्घ <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 Worthy of respect or reverence. .²7 It is also said to have the senses of assent, prosperity, and distress.
